file_roles.evidence: In JOIN::exec_inner the condition 'if (select_lex->have_window_funcs())' becomes '... && send_row_on_empty_set()', so the window-function step is skipped when no rows are produced.

rationale: The crash is in remove_duplicates, reached because exec_inner ran the window-function step on an empty result. The diff changes that decision in exec_inner, both in the same file.
